title: 2012 HMMT February Guts Problem 4
statement: Luna has an infinite supply of red, blue, orange, and green socks. She wants to arrange 2012 socks in a line such that no red sock is adjacent to a blue sock and no orange sock is adjacent to a green sock. How many ways can she do this?

solutions.text: \(4 \cdot 3^{2011}\) Luna has 4 choices for the first sock. After that, she has 3 choices for each of 2011 remaining socks for a total of \(4 \cdot 3^{2011}\).
